card.name: Words just before 'symptomatic' treatment
card.fires_on: The word right before 'symptomatic' or 'supportive' in overdose sections, such as 'treat' or 'treatment is'. Also fires on the start of 'symptomatic' itself.

modes.label: Verb or 'is' before symptomatic
modes.description: Overdosage text where 'treat' or 'treatment is' leads into 'symptomatic(ally)'.
modes.example: In case of overdosage, discontinue medication,<< treat>> symptomatically, and institute supportive measures.

modes.label: Linking word in symptomatic and supportive
modes.description: The 'and' or 'is' joining symptomatic care with supportive care.
modes.example: Treatment is symptomatic<< and>> supportive; there is no specific antidote

modes.label: Inside symptomatic
modes.description: The start of the word symptomatic in treatment lists.
modes.example: platelet transfusions and<< sympt>>omatic treatment of mucositis.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write 'symptomatic', 'supportive', 'comfort' and similar care words next.
